other_conditions: Applicant must be a police personnel of West Bengal Police or Kolkata Police in ranks: Deputy Superintendent (Non‑WBPS)/Assistant Commissioner, Inspector, Sub‑Inspector/Sergeant, Assistant Sub‑Inspector, Constable, or equivalent ranks.

Total pay (Basic Pay + Grade Pay) determines eligibility: pay ≥ ₹18,000 can apply for “A” category flats (≈1123 sq ft); pay ≥ ₹15,000 can apply for “B” category flats (≈926 sq ft); pay ≥ ₹8,840 can apply for “C” category flats (≈794 sq ft).
Each police personnel may submit only one application; other family members cannot apply separately.
For joint applications, only an immediate family member (spouse, parent, or child) may be the second applicant.
Only one flat will be allotted to the selected applicant.
benefits_summary: Construction of various types of flats for all West Bengal police personnel.
